retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, saturated collage style featuring grainy photographic elements with thick colored outlines against a textured solid background.
triggerTerms: cutout photo with thick green stroke

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, low-fidelity composition characterized by photographic elements (denim, sneakers) that have been processed through high-contrast halftone filters. Subject matter is isolated with thick, vibrant green outlines and placed on a stippled blue field. The overall look mimics 1980s DIY punk or new wave zine aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Red sneakers contrasting against a bright blue background
Green outlines separating photographic subjects from the field
Halftone grain providing texture to denim and canvas surfaces
Diagonal placement of feet creating a sense of movement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two feet in sneakers enter from the top and bottom corners, scaled to dominate the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red sneaker in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal flow from the top-right leg down to the bottom-left shoe, following the angle of the feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central blue area acts as active negative space, emphasizing the cutout nature of the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Electric blue background with high-texture stippling.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated red for the primary subject (sneakers).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant grass green used for thick subject outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation across all channels with high-value whites in the laces and soles for pop.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly rounded corners on serifs to match the lo-fi print feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font usage to maintain DIY aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast collage of denim-clad legs and red sneakers. Apply a heavy halftone grain. Outline the subjects with a thick, solid green stroke. Place against a textured, stippled electric blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab-serif text in the bottom right corner, rotated 15 degrees upward, using a pale yellow color and wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the green outline thick and consistent?
Is the background texture visible and stippled?
Is the text rotated and widely spaced?

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone grain in the denim and red areas
Ensure the green stroke doesn't have a blur
Verify the text is in a slab-serif style
Confirm the background is a solid, textured blue
Check that the composition feels diagonal
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast photo cutout + thick vibrant stroke + stippled background + wide-tracked slab serif.
